name: Chloe
source:
One of Bonner Town’s city college most popular cheerleaders also happens to be Andy’s cousin. They used to spend a lot of time together when they were younger but haven’t seen each other in some years. She informs Andy that their grandmother is out of town and they will be home alone for some time.

She’s a sweet and stunning blonde who seems to have a special place for Andy in her big, BIG heart. Could this lead to something else? Play your cards right and, who knows, you might have some fun reconnecting!
